notes: The 3D viewer now drains the engine's queue before applying the model's transform, so a slow driver waits in a bounded call that reports instead of stalling in a call that cannot time out

The 3D viewer no longer destroys the model's asset explicitly at teardown — the engine destroy moments later frees the same resources, and the explicit destroy is the call a re-opened preview never returned from on the P30 Pro
No customer-visible changes — this build removes the two calls the P30 Pro's log stopped on
